limits: Only the eight complete returned abstracts, 79 acknowledged HTML blocks and six complete PDF text pages have fresh reading credit. The arXiv abstract is a separately acknowledged HTML block, not an additional publication.
Four prior sources reuse exact private capture hashes and their earlier depth: RECIST, FDA 2018 endpoints, Bucher and eight Cochrane blocks. No fresh or whole-document reading is inferred.
The SuperPlots publisher route returned a challenge; the legal PMC article was read instead. No challenge was bypassed.
Published transport HTML omits inline mathematical symbols in text extraction; its prose assumptions and the separate v1 text are distinguished.

Crossref lists consortium authors before named authors on two records. Print/online years, the shorter JAMA titles, the accepted legacy Rosselli DOI query, and absent GIVIO authorString are explicitly reconciled.
Untested claim-map bridges and all numerical examples remain premise-backed teaching, not empirical clinical results. Retained legacy assertions outside the named requirements are not recertified.
